description: Retrieve IP geolocation and other facts of a host’s IP address using the ipbase.com API.

parameters.name: apikey
parameters.description: The API key for the request if you need more requests.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: If the hostname parameter is set to true, the API response contains the hostname of the IP. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The IP you want to get the info for. If not specified the API detects the IP automatically.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: An ISO Alpha 2 Language Code for localizing the IP data. Default: "en"

examples:
- name: "Get IP geolocation information of the primary outgoing IP"
  community.general.ipbase_info:
  register: my_ip_info

- name: "Get IP geolocation information of a specific IP"
  community.general.ipbase_info:
    ip: "8.8.8.8"
  register: my_ip_info


- name: "Get IP geolocation information of a specific IP with all other possible parameters"
  community.general.ipbase_info:
    ip: "8.8.8.8"
    apikey: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
    hostname: true
    language: "de"
  register: my_ip_info
